The '''toxic hazard zone''' was created in the northern side of [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], when agents of the [[Dread Masters]] sabotaged bioforming nodes in the area. The nodes caused toxic plants to spread rapidly and mutate animals in the area..<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The toxic hazard zone appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
